records.question: 过去30天没有任何会话活动的用户有多少（流失用户）
agent_sqls:
WITH anchor AS (SELECT max(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id
  FROM sessions s, anchor a
  WHERE s.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND s.start_time >= a.d - 30
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM users) AS total_users,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM active) AS active_users_30d,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active ac WHERE ac.user_id = u.user_id)) AS churned_users

records.question: 使用了优惠券的订单和未使用优惠券的订单，客单价对比

SELECT
  CASE WHEN coupon_id IS NOT NULL THEN '用券订单' ELSE '未用券订单' END AS grp,
  COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
  ROUND(AVG(actual_amount), 2) AS aov,
  ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total,
  ROUND(AVG(discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount
FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

records.question: 从浏览商品 → 加入购物车 → 开始结算 → 支付成功的转化漏斗，各步骤的独立用户数
agent_sqls:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT user_id, event_name
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('view_product','add_to_cart','begin_checkout','purchase')
),
s1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'view_product'),
s2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'add_to_cart' AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM s1)),
s3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'begin_checkout' AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM s2)),
s4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM s3))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s1) AS step1_view,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM s2) AS step2_cart,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM s3) AS step3_checkout,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM s4) AS step4_purchase
records.detail: 命中 golden[all-time subset funnel] 4/4 步

records.question: 各获客渠道的用户 ARPU（人均消费）对比，给出最高的3个渠道
agent_sqls:
SELECT register_channel,
       COUNT(*) AS users,
       SUM(CASE WHEN first_paid_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buyers,
       ROUND(AVG(total_gmv), 2) AS arpu_all_users,
       ROUND(SUM(total_gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN first_paid_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 2) AS arpu_buyer
FROM mart_user_summary
GROUP BY register_channel
ORDER BY arpu_all_users DESC;

records.question: 按注册周做留存 cohort 分析，最近 8 个注册周的周留存矩阵是什么样？
agent_sqls:
WITH a AS (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot),
cohort AS (
    SELECT u.user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', u.registered_at::date) AS cohort_week
    FROM users u, a
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('week', u.registered_at::date) >= DATEADD(week, -7, DATE_TRUNC('week', a.d))
      AND u.registered_at::date <= a.d
),
activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', event_time::date) AS activity_week
    FROM events
),
raw AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_week,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 1 THEN c.user_id END) AS w1,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 2 THEN c.user_id END) AS w2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 3 THEN c.user_id END) AS w3,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 4 THEN c.user_id END) AS w4
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN activity act ON act.user_id = c.user_id
    GROUP BY c.cohort_week
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cohort_week, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS cohort_week,
    cohort_size,
    ROUND(w1::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w1_pct,
    ROUND(w2::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w2_pct,
    ROUND(w3::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w3_pct,
    ROUND(w4::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w4_pct
FROM raw
ORDER BY cohort_week;

WITH a AS (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot),
cohort AS (
    SELECT u.user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', u.registered_at::date) AS cohort_week
    FROM users u, a
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('week', u.registered_at::date) >= DATEADD(week, -7, DATE_TRUNC('week', a.d))
      AND u.registered_at::date <= a.d
),
activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', event_time::date) AS activity_week
    FROM events
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_week,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 1 THEN c.user_id END) AS w1,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 2 THEN c.user_id END) AS w2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 3 THEN c.user_id END) AS w3,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(week, c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) = 4 THEN c.user_id END) AS w4
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN activity act ON act.user_id = c.user_id
    GROUP BY c.cohort_week
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cohort_week, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS cohort_week,

    ROUND(w1::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w1_pct,
    ROUND(w2::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w2_pct,
    ROUND(w3::decimal(38,6) / cohort_size * 100, 1) AS w3_pct,

records.question: 最近7天的 GMV 和再往前7天相比是涨是跌？涨跌多少？
agent_sqls:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.dt > a.d - 7 THEN 'last7' ELSE 'prev7' END AS period,
       min(k.dt) AS start_dt, max(k.dt) AS end_dt,
       CAST(sum(k.gmv) AS decimal(14,2)) AS gmv
FROM mart_daily_kpi k, a
WHERE k.dt > a.d - 14 AND k.dt <= a.d
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
records.detail: 命中 golden[mart_daily_kpi wow] 两值均匹配
